# Requirements Quality Checklist: Codex Agent Support (Per-Agent Tabs)

**Purpose**: Unit-test the requirements in `spec.md` for completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage before implementation — does the spec say enough, precisely enough, to build the Codex tab safely and honestly?
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the REQUIREMENTS, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for every Codex source kind the feature claims — global/user, plugin, and project — including what each contributes when present and absent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the project source kind's conditional behavior (emitted only when a Codex project skills root is confirmed) specified as a requirement rather than only noted as research risk? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the minimum per-skill display fields (name, description, source kind, plugin name, on-disk location, enabled/disabled state)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are built-in (`.system`) skill requirements complete — how they are marked and how they differ from user-authored global skills? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are re-enable / restore requirements defined symmetrically for every disable path (plugin off→on, skill quarantine→restore)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Are failure-handling requirements defined for every Codex write action, not only the plugin toggle? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the spec define what the agent switcher shows when only one agent is detected? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK008 Is "disabled-because-plugin-off" defined precisely enough to distinguish it from active and from hidden in the displayed state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "metadata incomplete" defined with criteria for what makes Codex skill metadata missing/malformed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "duplicate-by-identity within Codex" defined distinctly from similarity-based overlap, with the rule for when two sources count as the same skill id? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Can SC-002's "at least 95% of installed Codex skills discovered" be objectively measured — is the ground-truth set and the counting method defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "reversible" quantified for FR-012/FR-013 — does it require byte-identical restoration, or only functional restoration with no data loss? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the "stable order" of agent tabs defined concretely (e.g., primary first) rather than left to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the tab-default requirements agree across the spec — is "Claude active by default" stated consistently in the clarification, FR-002, and acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Is per-agent independent search/filter state described consistently between the clarification answer, FR-004, and US1 acceptance scenario 3? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK016 Are plugin-off semantics consistent between US2 (display) and US3 (control) — same "global, all projects" meaning in both? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the "safe-by-default" statements in FR-016, FR-018, and the Assumptions agree on exactly which operations may write? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-018]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality (Success Criteria)

- [ ] CHK018 Is each Success Criterion (SC-001..006) tied to a verifiable observation rather than an implementation behavior? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001–006]
- [ ] CHK019 Does SC-004 ("shown state matches the actual `enabled` flag for 100% of plugins") define what is compared and when (every scan)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK020 Does SC-006 ("says so before applying in 100% of global-only disables") define what counts as the tool "saying so"? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK021 Is SC-005 ("zero unintended modifications") given an observable boundary (no disk/config change absent an explicit action)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the zero-Codex-skills case (tab hidden even when Codex is installed)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a missing/unreadable Codex source (report which source failed, still show the rest)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for out-of-tool changes (user hand-edits `config.toml`) reflecting real on-disk state on next scan? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for switching tabs mid-action (in-flight action completes against its originating agent)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery requirements defined when a Codex action fails partway (config left in prior consistent state, no half-write)? [Recovery, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the same-skill-id-in-two-Codex-sources duplicate case covered as a requirement, not just an example? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-011]

## Safe-by-Default & Honest-Boundary (feature-critical)

- [ ] CHK028 Is the requirement that scanning/viewing/overlap NEVER mutates stated unambiguously and applied to the Codex tab specifically? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements clear that a global-only disable must be labeled global BEFORE applying, and must not imply folder scope it cannot deliver? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the built-in destructive-remove prohibition specified as a hard requirement (a `.system` skill is never offered for destructive remove)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Does FR-019 define how the tool distinguishes verified on-disk/config facts from suggestions (overlap) and from capabilities Codex lacks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the boundary documented for FR-014 vs FR-015 — when a folder-scoped disable is possible vs when only a global disable exists? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 Is the assumption that Codex stores plugin `enabled` in `~/.codex/config.toml` `[plugins."<name>@<marketplace>"]` validated and recorded as a dependency? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the unconfirmed Codex project-skill path explicitly flagged as an open assumption that must not produce a fabricated path? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions; Research §2]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the dependency on the `002-skill-inspector` model/trait/registry (reuse, not rebuild) documented so the spec stays consistent with that base? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK036 Is there any unresolved ambiguity in "the currently active agent unambiguous in the interface" — is a measurable indicator required? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK037 Does the spec resolve whether the cross-agent overlap view stays visible while the inventory is filtered to one agent, or is that a latent conflict? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011 vs §FR-002]

## Notes

- Check items off as resolved: `[x]`; annotate gaps inline with the spec section that needs the fix.
- An unchecked item means the requirement is unclear/missing — fix `spec.md`, not the code.
- Traceability: ≥80% of items cite a spec section or carry a `[Gap]`/`[Ambiguity]`/`[Conflict]`/`[Assumption]` marker.
